notes.title: First Major Update for "Fairy Spirit Chronicles" - It's Explosive!
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Patch 20250523[/h1]

[h2]New Tower Climb Mode[/h2]
[h3]In Tower Climb Mode, you must challenge each level sequentially from the first to the last, with no unexpected interruptions.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/4c339bd6455c92f71cc9c2ebcbff1620c0a2545f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Challenge Mode[/h2]
[h3]In Challenge Mode, the difficulty increases progressively with each level. Can you conquer them all?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/615150d693acadc35f129514b5a28b14fdc8b9ef.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reset for Normal, Step, and Time Limit Modes[/h2]
[h3]All modes have been reset with completely revamped, beautifully adjusted artwork. Each mode now features 21 stunning images in varying styles. If unsatisfied, feel free to leave comments for potential replacements.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/fb72d34386faa4b94daa83e6cad68417bcceba79.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Steam Achievements[/h2]
[h3]Added new Steam achievements, bringing the total count to 22.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/05f23fc529c1dc3a4ec94eaf9ac81e949b660134.jpg[/img]

[h2]Three New BGM Tracks[/h2]
[h3]Added three new background music tracks: "Light Melody," "Serene Tune," and "Joyful Rhythm."[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/5539ebf223eb160a139aeeaf37b8cb0c707d2336.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gallery Mode Reset[/h2]
[h3]Gallery Mode has been expanded to five volumes, with each volume now corresponding to different game modes.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/054beb3e5ecf3e1a92923e797f08a07733c41469.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other Minor Adjustments[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/77bfc10fa61bcb1491b28551e565d915a8bbab5a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Immortal Spirits' Atlas is now officially available!
notes.notes:
Piece together the myriad wonders and paint dreams of the immortal spirits—Immortal Spirits' Atlas is now officially available on Steam! You're invited to join in crafting this fantastical world with us!
This is a simple jigsaw puzzle game. It doesn't have gorgeous graphics, flashy skills, or unique creativity. However, playing such a small game occasionally can be a good way to relax and lift your spirits. It's also a nice addition to your collection!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/f94530517f2c39ec48b6a58cd2a479011685ddc1.png[/img]
